classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A model class responsible for generating coupon-related reports within the OpenCart admin extension. It provides methods to retrieve individual coupon data and aggregate coupon counts, supporting date filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons with their associated order counts and total amounts, with support for date range filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons matching the specified date range filters.
